dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: It's necessary to keep everyone's spirits up. Too loud? Ha! How could it possibly be too loud?

dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: The only problem is that it keeps breaking down... It used to start working again if you smacked it a couple of times. But that doesn't work now. I think we need someone to actually give it some serious maintenance...
